_about: Giving committees that FEC codes as a corporation (org type C or W) but that are not a company giving its own money. Each was reviewed by hand. An entry here moves the committee to other_pac for every cycle. Add an entry only with a source a reader can open. Reviewed 2026-11-18.

committees.name: DEMOCRACY ENGINE, INC., PAC
committees.reason: Conduit. It forwards individual donors' earmarked gifts; its own Schedule B lists each one on line 23 as 'EARMARK OF <donor>'. The money is the donors', not the company's.

committees.name: THE CENTER FOR FREETHOUGHT EQUALITY PAC
committees.reason: Connected organization is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit (EIN 52-2448073). FEC itself recodes the PAC as a membership group (M) from 2026.

committees.name: OUR REVOLUTION PAC
committees.reason: The PAC of Our Revolution, a political advocacy group. FEC lists no company as its connected organization, and recoded it from C (2020) to W (2022) and T (2024).

committees.name: PENNSYLVANIA FEDERATION OF DEMOCRATIC WOMEN INC FEDERAL PAC
committees.reason: A federation of Democratic women's clubs: a political membership group, not a business. FEC coded it W (non-stock corporation) through 2022 and M (membership group) from 2024.

committees.name: PFAW VOTERS ALLIANCE
committees.reason: Connected organization is People For the American Way, a 501(c)(4) nonprofit (EIN 52-1366721). FEC coded the PAC W in 2018 and M (membership group) from 2020.
